create_PinwheelHawkes_dataset: create a PinwheelHawkes dataset with 10 classes and 2D Hawkes process event sequences
create_GMMHawkes_dataset: create a GMMHawkes dataset with 3 classes and 1D Hawkes process event sequences
generate_hawkes_sequence: generate a spatio-temporal event sequence from an MHP model and data function
create_pinwheel_data: create pinwheel-shaped synthetic data points for a given number of samples and classes
create_gmm_data: create Gaussian Mixture Model synthetic data points for a given number of samples
